requirements.name: Source Trust / Attestation
requirements.required_evidence: Exact source implementation/configuration hash,independent root,Host/Boot and original-target coverage semantics,revocation and auditability.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Signed binaries,platform attestation,provider identity can support provenance.
requirements.evidence_gap: No concrete original-target source attests that every relevant window transition is emitted and recorded.
requirements.counterexample: A genuine signature authenticates a signed incomplete stream.
requirements.independent_verification: Independent source/vendor review plus attested source-to-journal semantics;not observer self-certification.

requirements.name: Pre-observation Readiness
requirements.required_evidence: Attested source subscription/epoch+consumer readiness barrier before interval and creation,or independently trusted prior history.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Hook/session registration and message-loop readiness are prospective mechanisms.
requirements.evidence_gap: No creation-history bridge for an already-existing original target is supplied.
requirements.counterexample: Window born before listener is absent from received CREATE stream.
requirements.independent_verification: Verify source-side barrier,consumer readiness and clock/order relation;reject unbridged prior lifetime.

requirements.name: Creation-anchored Generation
requirements.required_evidence: Nonreused source-generated generation committed at creation,linked to exact process/window instance.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: HWND and creator PID/TID;owner-side creation instrumentation for a cooperating owner.
requirements.evidence_gap: No qualified generation source for original target;process creation is not window creation.
requirements.independent_verification: Verify independent creation anchor and lineage;never infer timestamp from HWND.

requirements.name: Complete Interval Certificate
requirements.required_evidence: Exact authorized object/window universe including excluded candidates,begin/end,fences,coverage semantics,epochs and all creation/destruction transitions.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Provider-specific event streams and owner journals can contribute evidence.
requirements.evidence_gap: No independently justified original-target emission universe and full interval certificate.
requirements.counterexample: Two observers agree on the same omitted event.
requirements.independent_verification: Compare against independently trusted source/oracle and outside interval certificate;scope every object ID/child/domain.

requirements.name: Loss / Gap / Reordering
requirements.required_evidence: Source-generated order and loss detectability,epoch continuity,reentrancy resolution,buffer statistics and unknown policy.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: WinEvent queue order;application reentrancy control;ETW session statistics and consumption timestamps.
requirements.evidence_gap: Zero transport counters cannot prove source emission;timestamp/completion order differs from causal source order.
requirements.counterexample: Disabled event source yields zero recorded losses;completion reentrancy swaps order.
requirements.independent_verification: Check sequence+chain+epochs+source semantics and all loss layers independently;unknown halts.

requirements.name: Host / Boot / Session / Desktop
requirements.required_evidence: Independent current attestation and exact authorized Host/Boot/Session/Desktop/WindowStation per source/observer/interval.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Context metadata and independently qualified platform attestation could contribute.
requirements.evidence_gap: No current identity/attestation is collected;historical or sampled context alone is insufficient.
requirements.counterexample: A valid stream from another boot or desktop is substituted.
requirements.independent_verification: Cross-bind all signed source/interval/head/target records to external pins;require fresh scope-qualified evidence.

requirements.name: Process / Window Binding
requirements.required_evidence: PID+process creation FILETIME+executable path/hash/file identity,HWND+TID+class+generation,with trusted clock mapping.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: GetWindowThreadProcessId and GetProcessTimes give complementary process/window metadata.
requirements.evidence_gap: These APIs alone do not provide window-generation provenance or continuity.
requirements.counterexample: PID restart or generation substitution preserves numeric IDs.
requirements.independent_verification: Validate entire process instance and creation anchor across all events and interval fences.

requirements.name: Independent Evidence Heads
requirements.required_evidence: Externally fixed initial sequence/head and final horizon/head,source/stream/scope digests and anti-fork ACK.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Hash chains and signatures are implementable offline.
requirements.evidence_gap: Head integrity does not establish whether the source emitted a complete stream.
requirements.counterexample: Attacker rehashes/re-signs a contiguous incomplete stream.
requirements.independent_verification: Compare independently supplied pins and full source universe;do not derive expected head from packet.

requirements.name: Timeout / Crash / Unknown
requirements.required_evidence: Bounded verified interval/deadline,durable one-shot intent,outcome/closure,external crash handling;unknown cannot resume/retry/fallback.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Owner lifecycle messages and journals can support a separately qualified design.
requirements.evidence_gap: Crash,power-loss,readiness and trusted-clock guarantees are not supplied by window callbacks.
requirements.counterexample: Owner or observer dies between transition and journal commitment.
requirements.independent_verification: Independent supervisor/storage/clock qualification;preserve partial state and consume failed attempt.

requirements.name: Independent Reviewer ACK
requirements.required_evidence: Separate reviewer binds exact source/scope/interval/heads/evidence and states qualification scope;no diagnostic grant implied.
requirements.available_windows_mechanism: Independent engineering review is feasible;runtime ACK requires actual qualified evidence.
requirements.evidence_gap: No original-target runtime evidence exists for review or execution authorization.
requirements.counterexample: A signed ACK for synthetic or incomplete evidence is promoted to native PASS.
requirements.independent_verification: Reproduce verification at exact head with separate roots and explicit scope;refuse cross-target/authority promotion.
